claims.text: Agent systems can be categorized into software-based, physical, and adaptive hybrid systems.
Integration of multi-modal LLMs enables agent systems to process text, images, audio, and structured tabular data.

evidence.description: We categorize agent systems into software-based, physical, and adaptive hybrid systems, highlighting applications across customer service, software development, manufacturing automation, personalized education, financial trading, and healthcare.
With the integration of multi-modal LLMs, current agent systems are highly capable of processing diverse data modalities, including text, images, audio, and structured tabular data.

methodologies.name: Taxonomy and Systemic Review Framework
methodologies.description: A comprehensive classification framework categorizing agent architectures across software, physical, and hybrid domains.

limitations.text: LLM-powered agents suffer from high inference latency.
LLM-powered agents lack standardized evaluation metrics.

future_work.text: Propose solutions to mitigate high inference latency, output uncertainty, lack of evaluation metrics, and security vulnerabilities in LLM-powered agent systems.
